blocks.text: Subject to site survey and specifications as per your emails.
Further to your RFQ dated {{ rfq_date }}, below is our technical proposal with the product brands. Prices are in quotation {{ quotation_no }}.

items: Load per screen: 16.24 kW max (approx. 26 A), 4.87 kW average
Supply: 400 V, 3-phase, TN-S, one dedicated feeder per screen
ABB Tmax XT MCCB, lugs and connection at each source board, sized to the feeder
Earth-fault protection on the Screen-1 feeder
Labelling and termination at each source board
Riyadh Cables XLPE 0.6/1 kV, IEC 60502-1: 4C × 25 mm² (Screen-1), 4C × 16 mm² (Screens 2–4) [1]
Separate 1C × 16 mm² earth conductor with each feeder
Outdoor: 110 mm uPVC duct at 0.8 m depth on sand bed, warning tape, pull pits at bends
Screen-1: ~100 m outdoor trench, balance (~250 m) in the in-building raceway
Risers: rigid GI conduit where cables leave the ground at source and screen ends
Indoor: galvanised cable tray or rigid steel conduit in B1 MDB rooms
Excavation, backfill, asphalt and tile reinstatement
IP65 lockable outdoor enclosure on plinth
ABB 200 A 3P MCCB incomer
ABB Type 2 surge arrester [3][4]
ABB MCB (screen circuit) and ABB 30 mA RCBO (sockets) [2]
Copper earth busbar bonded to earth conductor, enclosure, screen structure and earth rod
Power cables: Riyadh Cables
MCCB, MCB, RCBO, surge protection: ABB
Others: Generic
Insulation resistance, continuity, polarity and phase checks
Earth resistance at each rod: 5 Ohm or less
RCD trip test, energisation with Digital City
As-built drawings and completion report
Spare outgoing way at each source board; otherwise sub-board quoted separately
Work permits and Digital City coordination included
[1] Riyadh Cables – LV Power Cables catalogue
[2] ABB – RCBO DS201 data sheet
[3] ABB – Electrical installation solutions for buildings, Protection and safety (B05)
[4] ABB – Surge protective devices (SPDs) catalogue
